beats.text: This is the GI Hub, signed in as a Store Keeper. Everything you can see here is scoped to your site — and so is everything the assistant will tell you.

beats.note: The assistant opens from any page
beats.text: The Hub Assistant sits on every page, bottom right. Open it whenever you are unsure what a screen expects from you.

beats.note: Asked in the store keeper's own words
beats.text: Ask it in your own words. You do not need to know which chapter of the manual the answer lives in.

beats.note: The question goes to the LOCAL model
beats.text: The question is answered by a model running on the company's own server. Nothing you type here leaves the network.

beats.note: Answered from the Store Keeper chapters only
beats.text: The answer comes from the Store Keeper chapters of the user manual, and only those. Ask about a screen your role cannot open and it will say so rather than guess.
Close it and carry on. Next in this series: receiving stock against a delivery note.
